screen.mdvlcraft.abilities.none: No abilities yet. Unlock spells and techniques in your archetype skill trees.
screen.mdvlcraft.abilities.hint_pick: Click an ability, then a wheel slot. Right-click a slot to empty it.
ability.mdvlcraft.dismantle.desc: Fire an invisible slash that cuts the first thing it hits.
ability.mdvlcraft.cleave.desc: Hold to carve repeatedly at a target in front of you.
ability.mdvlcraft.malevolent_shrine.desc: Cast to open your domain; everything inside is cut apart. Cast again to close it (free). It lasts up to 20 seconds.
ability.mdvlcraft.boogie_woogie.desc: Clap to swap places with the creature you are looking at (10 blocks).
ability.mdvlcraft.block_clap.desc: Clap to swap places with the block you are looking at.
mdvlcraft.ponder.weapon_combo.text_1:
Press [Attack] repeatedly to chain this weapon's basic combo.
Every weapon of this type shares the moveset.
mdvlcraft.ponder.weapon_combo.text_2: Attack while sprinting to perform a [Dash Attack].
mdvlcraft.ponder.weapon_combo.text_3: Attack in mid-air to perform an [Air Attack].
mdvlcraft.ponder.weapon_ranged.text_1:
Hold [Use] to draw and aim, then release to fire.
Epic Fight aims along your view in battle mode.
ability.mdvlcraft.stance.desc: Cast to take up or drop your stance. Sneak and cast to change its element.
stance.mdvlcraft.switched: %s Stance ready (%s). Cast to take it up
